# Super Mario World (SNES) Reverse Engineering — Knowledge Base

GitMCP endpoint: https://gitmcp.io/ethanhunt1981/smw-reverse-engineering-kb

## What this is for

Byte-exact reverse engineering of Super Mario World (SNES, Ricoh 5A22 / WDC 65816, LoROM): WLA disassembly, Ghidra C-decompilation, Python reimplementation, graphics, audio, level format, sprite AI. Useful for researchers, modders, and AI agents exploring SMW internals.

Not for: distributing the ROM, piracy, or production game shipping.
